scope: 12 newly recognized Special Energy components and fully supported additional cards; no previous supported program or metadata changes.

sources.title: Mist Energy
sources.checkedFacts: Prevents effects of opposing attacks on its host; damage is distinct.

sources.title: Wash Water Energy
sources.checkedFacts: Only the Water host receives protection from effects of opposing attacks.

sources.title: Wonder Energy
sources.checkedFacts: Fairy-only attachment and continuous discard; existing effects are not removed.

sources.title: Fusion Strike Energy
sources.checkedFacts: One selectable Energy unit, Fusion Strike host restriction and opposing Ability effect protection.

sources.title: V Guard Energy
sources.checkedFacts: Reduces opposing Pokemon V attack damage by 30; multiple copies do not stack on the same host.

sources.title: Official FAQ: Weakness Guard versus Psystrike-GX
sources.checkedFacts: Psystrike-GX still deals 200, not 400, to a Psychic-weak host with Weakness Guard. Ignoring effects on the defender does not restore removed Weakness.

sources.title: Temple of Sinnoh official strategy
sources.checkedFacts: Special Energy effects disappear under the override and become one Colorless unit.

boundaries: 12 complete Energy definitions including reprints; no older supported program or metadata change.
No-Weakness affects only Weakness application, remains effective against attacks ignoring defender damage effects, and never applies Bench Weakness.
Effects-only protection does not block attack damage or cure earlier conditions. Opponent Ability protection does not block own effects, attacks or non-card rule hooks.
V Guard non-stacking is local to each host and group; distinct reduction groups and old additive guards remain additive.
Shadow only blocks opposing attack damage to its Dark-type Benched host; counters are effects.
Effects follow current attached source, host type and position, independent of Ability/Tool suppression and subject to Energy override.
No artwork, client, installation or GameTest changes.
